data.note: (lo məḷḷele mede ḥarbo, bas u+greʕo ġalabe nafəl qəm ruḥe ‘he was very much upset’) (p.c. Ilyas 09-05-2022)

rationale: The raw example puts 'he was very much upset' inside a parenthetical explanation of nafəl qəm ruḥe. The current split assigns the embedded gloss to the entire example and leaves an unclosed parenthesis in turoyo. Repartition the existing material without adding a translation.
